hints.title: Ordered Factor Enumeration
hints.text: Generate factor candidates in non-decreasing order to avoid duplicate permutations.

hints.title: Recursive Divisor Pruning
hints.text: Branch only on valid divisors d <= sqrt(remainder) and decrement the remaining factor count.

hints.title: Min-Max Difference Tracking
hints.text: When one factor remains, assign the remaining quotient and update the minimal spread recorded.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: D(N): number of divisors of N
complexity.notes: DFS branch-and-bound traversal over divisors up to depth K.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all K-tuples without divisor constraints exceeds limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Recursion call stack bounded by depth K.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforce sorted factor order to prevent combinatorial explosion.
